property_summary: For any target contract_address and parallel arrays tos/vs, the reference C always invokes transferFrom(msg.sender, tos[i], vs[i]) on the callee so the low-level call succeeds iff the callee accepts that selector; the mutant instead invokes transfer(tos[i], vs[i]) which can have different success behavior for some callee implementations (so there exist inputs where reference succeeds but mutant fails or vice versa).
change_summary: Change the call target for transferFrom so it calls transfer instead of transferFrom (modify selector to transfer(address,uint256)).
